results.alertTitle: Sign-in attempts against disabled account johns@m365x816222.onmicrosoft.com

summary.tpReason: This is hostile activity, not a benign disabled-account login: four password authentications for JohnS were rejected with Entra error 50057 (account disabled) from Pyongyang/KP IP 175.45.176.99. The same IP subsequently made 53 successful interactive sign-ins as adelev and performed unauthorized-looking SharePoint/OneDrive sharing, upload, modification, and deletion activity.
summary.fpReason: A legitimate owner could theoretically use the same source address and perform document sharing, but this does not explain repeated password attempts against a disabled account, the North Korea geolocation, or the tightly associated anomalous access and permission/link changes. No benign administrative/audit explanation was found.
summary.whatHappened: The alert is timestamped 2026-08-19, but its supporting disabled-account records are dated 2021-04-19 12:13:19–12:16:34 UTC: 175.45.176.99 (Pyongyang, KP) made four interactive Azure Portal password attempts as johns@m365x816222.onmicrosoft.com (JohnS), all blocked because the account was disabled (50057). The same IP later successfully accessed adelev@m365x816222.onmicrosoft.com from 11:01–12:11 UTC on 2021-11-04 (53 successful sign-ins). It then accessed/modified SharePoint and OneDrive content, created sharing/permission changes and an anonymous link for AdeleV's "Contoso Purchasing Data - Q1.xlsx" at 11:36:30–11:36:31, and deleted "Timesheet_AdeleV.xlsx" at 11:37:41. Office telemetry also attributes activity as JohnS from this IP, including upload of Document.docx and company-link/sharing changes on 2021-11-04 11:12–11:16 UTC.
keyEvidence: disable_accounts_CL has exactly four JohnS attempts from 175.45.176.99 at 2021-04-19 12:13:19–12:16:34 UTC; each used a cloud password and failed with ResultType 50057: "User account is disabled." Location is Pyongyang, North Korea.

sign_in_adelete_CL records 56 sign-ins from 175.45.176.99 on 2021-11-04; 53 succeeded (ResultType 0), all for adelev@m365x816222.onmicrosoft.com, beginning with an Azure Portal interactive login at 11:01:00 UTC.

OfficeActivity_CL shows 129 actions by adelev from the IP during 11:20–11:42 UTC, including an AnonymousLinkCreated and sharing/permission changes for Contoso Purchasing Data - Q1.xlsx, plus deletion of Timesheet_AdeleV.xlsx.
OfficeActivity_CL attributes 35 JohnS SharePoint actions from the IP at 11:12–11:16 UTC, including Document.docx upload, permission-level additions, sharing changes, and CompanyLinkCreated.
researchDone: Reviewed alert record in SecurityAlert; it is the only matching alert and is timestamped 2026-08-19, while correlated source telemetry is dated 2021. This timestamp discrepancy should be validated as ingestion/lab-date behavior.
Queried disable_accounts_CL directly and confirmed all four failed disabled-account password attempts, their error reason, IP, user agent, and KP geolocation.
Queried sign_in_adelete_CL for JohnS and source-IP activity. No JohnS rows were present in that table, but the source IP had 56 records for adelev, 53 successful.
Reviewed OfficeActivity_CL for the source IP and both named accounts; found file/permission/link actions described above, including data-sharing and deletion.
Queried AuditLogsHunting_CL for source-IP and relevant target activity; no matching directory audit records were returned.
Checked Office activity for the alert period itself (2026-08-19); no matching entries were returned; available corroborating activity is historical 2021 telemetry.
